units.source_text: 店铺的红格子门就是证据。

en.t: The shop's red lattice door is the evidence.

units.source_text: 古老的格子门对我最了解不过了。”

en.t: That old lattice door knows me better than anyone."

units.source_text: 千重子的声音越发迷人了，

en.t: Chieko's voice grew still more enchanting,

units.source_text: “记得我刚上中学的时候，妈妈把我找去告诉我：

en.t: "I remember when I had just started middle school, Mother called me over and told me:

units.source_text: ‘千重子，你不是我的亲生女儿。

en.t: 'Chieko, you are not my real daughter.

units.source_text: 我们抢到了一个招人喜欢的婴儿，

en.t: We snatched up a lovable baby,

units.source_text: 就一溜烟似的坐车逃跑了。’

en.t: then jumped into a car and fled as fast as smoke.'

units.source_text: 可是，抢婴儿的地点，爸妈有时不经心，说法不一致。

en.t: But when it came to where they had snatched the baby, Father and Mother sometimes spoke carelessly, and their stories did not match.

units.source_text: 一个说是在赏夜樱的祇园里，

en.t: One said it was in Gion, while they were viewing the cherry blossoms at night,

units.source_text: 一个则说是在鸭川河滩上……

en.t: while the other said it was on the riverbank of the Kamo River...

units.source_text: 他们准是觉得说我是被扔在店铺门前的弃儿，太可怜了，

en.t: They must have thought it was too pitiful to say I was an abandoned child left in front of the shop,
so they made up that story..."
